body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-16, my own miss on w-78d488660ee9, evaluation delegation-bdf4da90 voided). Never change the named source root (git switch, checkout or edits) in the same turn as termal_evaluate_acceptance. The host records the turn's source change when the turn ends, after the request's evidence basis, and Engram then refuses the evaluator's submission: "a source change observed without admission at run-feed position N+1 occurred after evidence basis N, making this evaluation void". That wastes the evaluator slot. Move the root or edit in one turn; request the evaluation in a LATER turn with no source change.
